title: Rootha Na Karo
desc: Naina is in love with Sudhir and is disheartened when she learns he is in love with her cousin, Neeta. She attempts to separate them by creating misunderstandings between them.

title: Naya Daur
desc: When the son of a landlord decides to modernize his business by replacing the horse carts with buses, a horse cart rider decides to challenge him.

title: Khoon Ka Karz
desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?
